method: Two fresh embedded-Python processes use the same newly-created isolated VIDEOAUTO_WORKSPACE_DIR. Process 1 starts without a cache; process 2 reuses its disk cache. Timings cover importing text_layout and the first subtitle tokenization in each process.
cache_policy: Only explicit VIDEOAUTO_DATA_ROOT or VIDEOAUTO_WORKSPACE_DIR may receive .videoautocut/cache/jieba. System temp, VIDEOAUTO_TEMP_DIR, and runtime/install trees are rejected. Missing, unwritable, or runtime-contained targets initialize the fixed dictionary in memory and do not fall back to per-character tokenization.
coverage: test_text_layout.py covers no workspace, external TEMP, writable workspace, unwritable workspace, workspace==runtime, runtime child, and workspace parent containing a separate runtime child.
